title: CHESS
creator: Ifun
limits: Native mesh cooking/render/entry have not run.

Raw archive geometry and source StandardMaterial overrides are ported; prepared adapter dynamic panels/aperture repair, spawn-floor reconstruction, fixtures, hazards and art repairs remain unported for this map. Static source panels are retained, not deleted.
Source foliage collision exclusion is applied; distant foliage LOD is not ported.
Source local support and capsule queries run against decoded original geometry, not Godot physics. No support geometry is invented.
Current v1 source shader retains its existing alpha-cutout lighting approximation; R6 architecture shader flags are a separate root-owned integration.
